title: Tavern Keeper Vouches for Mercenary Escort
description:
A {PC_ADJECTIVE} mercenary with a proven track record asks the tavern keeper
to vouch for {PC_OBJECT} to a caravan master hiring an escort for a
dangerous run requiring combat and heavy lifting.
scenario_text:
It's near closing time. A {PC_ADJECTIVE} mercenary who has taken jobs from
this tavern before walks up to the tavern keeper. {PC_SUBJECT} explains that a
merchant caravan master, currently at the bar, is looking to hire an
escort for a dangerous run through bandit-plagued roads at dawn
tomorrow, one that will likely require fighting off armed bandits
and hauling heavy supply crates over rough terrain. {PC_SUBJECT} has handled
jobs like this before, has no complaints on record, and has always
completed contracts without incident. {PC_SUBJECT} asks the tavern keeper to
vouch for {PC_OBJECT} to the caravan master before the night is out. The
tavern keeper must now decide how to respond.
